name: Jean-Pierre Dubois
bio:
Jean-Pierre Dubois, a native of Montreal, found his passion for motorsport not on the track, but in the intricate engineering of the vehicles themselves. After earning a degree in Mechanical Engineering from McGill University, he began his career with a small, independent racing team, rapidly rising through the ranks due to his meticulous approach and keen eye for detail. He quickly became known for his ability to optimize performance through innovative strategies and a data-driven approach.

Dubois's management style is marked by his unwavering loyalty and his ability to foster a strong team spirit, albeit often from a distance. He prefers to analyze data and make decisions based on evidence rather than gut feeling. At Racing Bulls, he oversees all sporting aspects, ensuring the team operates at peak efficiency and that strategic decisions align with the overall goals of the organization. His methodical nature and commitment to excellence make him a valuable asset.

While he respects team input, Dubois is ultimately a decisive leader who isn't afraid to make tough calls. He is seen as a bit of a 'lone wolf' by some due to his preference for independent analysis, but his commitment to the team's success is never in doubt.

physical.description: Jean-Pierre is a man of average height with a serious demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down observations.
Has a habit of tapping his pen when deep in thought.
Insists on a specific brand of espresso, prepared exactly to his specifications.
